charts.title: WASP-15 b: orbits around Nyamien
charts.description: The orbits of Nyamien's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-15 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Ivshina & Winn 2022 (2022ApJS..259...62I), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname IVSHINA__AMP__WINN_2022): P 3.7520997 d

charts.title: WASP-15 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-15 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (11, 102) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 111991770, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 15-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 15-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
